papers.title: DenseOn with the LateOn: Fully Open Dense and Late-Interaction Models for Multilingual, Long-Context, and Code Search
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art retrieval models increasingly rely on closed training data, creating a reproducibility gap. We present an open end-to-end recipe for training retrieval models and study how English supervision transfers to multilingual retrieval through translate-train. We first reconstruct and curate 665M English contrastive pre-training pairs from 1.4B pairs across 34 public sources and build 1.88M supervised fine-tuning pairs with mined hard negatives. Training yields two 149M-parameter model
papers.llm_reason: 提供了端到端完全开源的检索模型训练配方（DenseOn with the LateOn），直击当前 SOTA 检索模型越来越依赖闭源训练数据所造成的'可复现性鸿沟'这一 RAG 基础设施痛点。据摘要：从 34 个公开来源的 14 亿对中重建并精选出 6.65 亿英文对比预训练对，配合挖掘的难负样本构建 188 万监督微调对，训练出两个 1.49 亿参数的 dense 与 late-interaction 模型，并通过 translate-train 研究英文监督向多语言检索的迁移，覆盖多语言、长上下文与代码搜索。工程价值极高：数据配方全公开、可直接指导团队自建/微调检索模型、降低对闭源 embedding 服务的依赖。证据强度依赖论文正文（摘要自述，实验规模与基线对比待核验），代码/benchmark 链接暂无待核验。

papers.title: Mental World Modeling
papers.abstract: World models enable a predictive substrate for planning and action, yet existing formulations merely answer a physical question: what/where it is, and how will it evolve. Human behavior, however, is driven by hidden mental state (what a person believes, wants, intends, feels, and considers socially permissible), so a model that tracks the physical scene but not what each agent knows and believes about it predicts the wrong action for the right-looking scene. papers.llm_reason: 提出了 Mental World Modeling 框架，指出现有世界模型只回答物理问题（是什么/在哪/如何演化），却忽略了驱动人类行为的隐藏心理状态（信念、欲望、意图、感受、社会许可）——导致模型在'看起来对的场景'上预测出错误的行动。这一洞察直击 Agent/world model 研究的核心盲点：要预测人类/智能体的行为，必须建模'每个 agent 知道什么、相信什么'，而不仅是物理场景。对构建社交感知 agent、人机协作系统、具身规划的团队有直接的架构设计启发。理论创新度高（将心理状态建模纳入 world model），与 agent/world model/规划三大趋势交汇。证据强度依赖论文正文（摘要自述，具体形式化与实验待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Can AI agents conduct open-ended AI research? Early evidence from two case studies
papers.abstract: Forecasts of explosive AI progress hinge on AI agents automating AI research. But evidence on whether agents can carry out open-ended AI research is thin. Current evaluations either test agents on narrow, verifiable tasks, which excludes open-ended research, or submit AI-generated papers to blind peer review, which is overstretched, stochastic, and suffers from poor review quality. We introduce a third way to measure progress towards AI R\&D automation. An agent takes on the central, open-ended
papers.llm_reason: 提出测量 AI R&D 自动化进展的'第三种方式'：让 agent 承担开放式 AI 研究的中心任务，弥补现有评测要么只测窄任务（排除开放式研究）、要么依赖过度承压且质量不稳定的盲审两条路径的不足。直击'AI agent 能否自动化 AI 研究'这一影响 AGI 预测的关键问题，为判断 agent 开放式研究能力提供了新方法论。趋势信号强：属于 agent 能力评测与 R&D 自动化这一核心趋势的代表案例。证据强度依赖论文正文（两个案例研究的具体设计、结果与可复现性待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: APEX-Accounting
papers.abstract: We introduce APEX-Accounting, a benchmark built by Mercor in partnership with Ramp, to assess whether frontier models can do the real work of accountants. Tasks include reconciling accounts, accruing expenses, posting transactions, and producing reports. The private eval set comprises 160 tasks, split across 10 worlds. papers.llm_reason: APEX-Accounting 是 Mercor 与 Ramp 合作构建的 benchmark，评估前沿模型能否完成会计师的真实工作（对账、计提、过账、出具报告）。据摘要：私有评测集含 160 个任务、分布在 10 个'世界'中，每个世界包含会计系统及电子表格、PDF 等文件，任务由会计与簿记专家编写并解答。直击'前沿模型能否做真实世界专业工作流'这一 agent 落地趋势，属于真实世界 agentic benchmark 的代表案例。趋势价值高于即时工程价值（评测集为私有，团队无法直接复现），方法论（多世界+多文件+专家级任务设计）可借鉴。证据强度依赖论文正文（任务设计细节、模型表现与统计待核验）。

papers.title: Do You Really Need to Pretrain Q-Functions for Online RL Fine-Tuning?
papers.abstract: Pre-training followed by fine-tuning has become the dominant recipe for learning performant policies, and in value-based reinforcement learning (RL) this raises a natural question: given a pretrained policy, should the Q-function be pretrained on offline data too? Conventional wisdom suggests it should, but recent results show that online RL with a randomly-initialized Q-function can result in highly performant and reliable policies without needing to pretrain the Q-function. In this paper, we s
papers.llm_reason: 针对预训练+微调范式下的一个自然问题：给定预训练策略，Q 函数是否也需要在离线数据上预训练？据摘要：近期结果显示，在线 RL 用随机初始化的 Q 函数也能得到高性能可靠策略，无需预训练 Q 函数。这对依赖预训练+在线 RL 微调的团队有方法论参考价值（可能简化训练流程、降低离线数据依赖）。但属于 RL 训练范式的细化研究，与当前 LLM/Agent 工程栈的直接迁移距离中等，更适合作为长尾资产跟踪。证据强度依赖论文正文（实验设定、任务范围与消融待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: Partner Capability Estimation for Task-Agnostic Adaptation in Ad-Hoc Teamwork
papers.abstract: Effective collaboration with novel and diverse partners is a crucial skill for autonomous agents. Most current ad-hoc teamwork (AHT) approaches assume that agents will collaborate on a single, fixed task and that the partner's capabilities, their ability to successfully execute the desired action, are already known. papers.llm_reason: 研究临时团队协作（ad-hoc teamwork）中的伙伴能力估计问题：现有方法假设单一固定任务且伙伴能力已知，但现实中伙伴真实能力往往隐藏、人类可能在多策略任务上表现次优。据摘要提出对此进行扩展。对多 agent 协作与人机协作的智能体设计有参考价值，但研究范围相对聚焦（AHT 子领域），与主流 Agent 工程栈的直接迁移距离中等。作为长尾资产保存。证据强度依赖论文正文（任务设定、方法与实验待核验），代码/benchmark 暂无待核验。

papers.title: The Social Cost of an AI Teammate: How an Artificial Teammate Reshapes Human-Human Communication in Small-Team Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Conversational AI is increasingly positioned as a teammate rather than a tool, yet we know little about how its presence reshapes communication among the humans on the team. We examined sociocognitive communication dynamics in team decision-making using Group Communication Analysis (GCA), team surveys, and lexical analyses of team discourse. papers.llm_reason: 随机对照实验研究'AI 队友'如何重塑小团队中人与人之间的沟通。据摘要：用群体沟通分析（GCA）、团队问卷与词汇分析，比较 16 个'双人+AI 队友'团队与 17 个全人类团队在高风险道德困境决策任务上的表现。对理解 AI agent 作为队友（而非工具）对人类协作动力学的影响有社会学/HC 价值，但与 AI 工程栈的直接技术迁移有限，更适合作为'人机协作设计'的长尾参考。证据强度依赖论文正文（样本量、效应量与统计显著性待核验）。

papers.title: Pangram 4 Technical Report
papers.abstract: We present Pangram 4, the latest deep-learning-based AI-text classification model from Pangram Labs. We achieve an AUROC of 0.9916 with a false positive rate of 0.0041% and a false negative rate of 0.3396%. In addition to its increased overall accuracy compared with Pangram 3, Pangram 4 exhibits superior out-of-distribution generalization and robustness to adversarial attacks. papers.llm_reason: Pangram 4 是 Pangram Labs 的 AI 文本检测（AI-text classification）模型技术报告。据摘要：AUROC 0.9916、误报率 0.0041%、漏报率 0.3396%，并改进了细粒度编辑与 AI-人类混合写作的区分能力。属于特定厂商的产品技术报告，与团队 AI 工程/Agent 技术栈的直接相关性有限，方法论（检测模型训练）也非当前重点方向。作为噪声忽略，除非团队专门做内容检测/安全审计。
